Board — F = m r̈
$\underline{F} = m\,\ddot{\underline{r}}$
Forward: given $\underline{F}$, integrate twice for the motion.
Backward: given the motion, differentiate twice and read off $\underline{F}$.
Practice 1

A mass $m$ moves so that $\underline{r}(t) = \left\langle 2\alpha t^3,\; 0\right\rangle$, with $\alpha$ constant. What force is acting on it?

$$\underline{r}=\left\langle 2\alpha t^3,\,0\right\rangle\;\to\;\ddot{\underline r}=\langle 12\alpha t,\,0\rangle\;\to\;\underline{F}=\langle 12m\alpha t,\,0\rangle$$

A force along $x$ that grows linearly in time.

Practice 2

A mass $m$ moves so that $\underline{r}(t) = \left\langle v_x t,\; h - \tfrac12 g t^2,\; 0\right\rangle$. What force is acting?

$$\underline{r}=\left\langle v_x t,\,h-\tfrac12 gt^2,\,0\right\rangle\;\to\;\ddot{\underline r}=\langle 0,\,-g,\,0\rangle\;\to\;\underline{F}=\langle 0,\,-mg,\,0\rangle$$

A constant force along $-y$.

BNone of them
